mostWorthwhile.text: Joining capillaries to body cells was most worthwhile because it showed what moves between blood and cells, and why the vessels need thin walls.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the venous wall was a little repetitive after lining the artery, though I had overlooked that it was needed.

surprise.text: I expected to add the valves directly, but the vein needed its lining first. The automatic hint made that prerequisite clear.

arbitrary.text: The lining requirement was easy to miss, but it made sense once the hint pointed it out; no action felt completely purposeless.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the routes into a whole network was satisfying, and I would be curious to see how it connects to the heart.
